idxStocks.title: IDX Stocks Dashboard
idxStocks.summary: A dashboard for exploring and monitoring Indonesian stock market data.
idxStocks.description: A focused dashboard experience for working with IDX stock information in one place.
idxStocks.problem: Stock-market information is easier to evaluate when the relevant data can be reviewed in a single, structured workspace.
idxStocks.solution: RisenDev built a dedicated dashboard interface for exploring and monitoring IDX stock data.
idxStocks.engineering: The project is structured as a data-focused web application, designed around readable information hierarchy and repeatable dashboard views.

scope.0: Interactive market terminal with IHSG, gainers, losers, and active movers
scope.1: Five-year candlestick charts with SMA, EMA, RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, ATR, and volume analysis
scope.2: Annual and quarterly financial statements with valuation and performance ratios
scope.3: Fundamental screener, watchlists, and Google News RSS integration
scope.4: Quant and multi-agent AI paper-trading research with strategy-performance analytics
scope.5: Automated Telegram market briefs and operations-health monitoring

facts.1: Self-hosted deployment with systemd services and timers
facts.2: Integrated with multiple AI providers through 9Router for market-data analysis
facts.3: Hermes Agent-compatible delivery for daily, weekly, or yearly market data, performance, and signals
facts.4: Browser UI communicates with the FastAPI backend over HTTP and SSE

idxStocks.outcome: The dashboard brings IDX stock exploration and monitoring into a structured workspace.

aiSummarizer.title: Summarizer Powered by AI Models
aiSummarizer.summary: An AI-assisted application for turning longer content into concise summaries.
aiSummarizer.description: A practical summarization workflow powered by AI models.
aiSummarizer.problem: Long-form content takes time to review, especially when the reader only needs the essential points.
aiSummarizer.solution: RisenDev built a focused application that uses AI models to generate concise summaries from supplied content.
aiSummarizer.engineering: The product centers on a simple input-to-summary flow so the AI capability remains useful without adding unnecessary complexity.
aiSummarizer.outcome: The application turns supplied content into concise summaries through a focused input-to-summary workflow.

odooWageOvertime.title: Odoo Custom Module for Wage and Overtime
odooWageOvertime.summary: A custom Odoo module for supporting wage and overtime workflows.
odooWageOvertime.description: Business workflow customization within an Odoo environment.
odooWageOvertime.problem: Wage and overtime processes need to reflect the operational rules a business already uses.
odooWageOvertime.solution: RisenDev developed a custom Odoo module to support wage and overtime processes within the existing ERP workflow.
odooWageOvertime.engineering: The module extends Odoo with a workflow-specific implementation instead of requiring teams to work around a generic process.
odooWageOvertime.outcome: Wage and overtime workflows are supported within the existing Odoo environment.

stockOpname.title: Stock Opname Application
stockOpname.summary: An application for supporting structured stock-opname activities.
stockOpname.description: A dedicated workflow for recording and reviewing physical stock counts.
stockOpname.problem: Physical stock counts are easier to manage when recording, review, and reconciliation follow one clear workflow.
stockOpname.solution: RisenDev built a stock-opname application to support structured inventory-counting activities.
stockOpname.engineering: The application focuses on clear operational steps so stock-count information can be captured and reviewed consistently.
stockOpname.outcome: The application provides a structured workflow for recording and reviewing physical stock counts.
